title: Project settings pane in the TUI: every setting by owner, and the setup steps
lead: *Proposed.* A key opens a pane for the active project that shows every setting, grouped by the tool that owns it (ork registry, ork global, slicer config, slicer relay roles, adj), from the `projects.show` read. From the pane the owner runs a setup step (`slicer init`, `slicer relay-roles init`, `adj init`, adj off) after a `[y/N]` confirm that shows the exact command, and opens the existing matrix pane. Field editing is not in this slice.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Owner, 2026-11-02: settings are set up per project, primarily from the UI. The TUI has no settings view today: it adds and removes projects (`internal/tui/welcome.go`, `internal/tui/projects.go`), and shows the role matrix read-only on the Roadmap (`m`, `internal/tui/roadmap.go:69`, `openMatrix`). Every other setting is CLI-only (`ork projects set`, `ork settings`, `ork projects pin`).

This slice depends on `projects-show` (the read) and `project-setup` (the steps), and does not start before both have landed. It changes nothing in the daemon. Matrix edits stay with S226 (matrix editor in the TUI) and the `matrix-apply` outline; the pane's `m` opens the same matrix pane S226 extends.

Design (*proposed*; the layout was accepted on 2026-11-02; the key is open: `S` is free in the key map (checked), and the owner was shown a comma as the recommendation by mistake, so confirm the key before the slice starts):
- Key `S` (free today: the key map in `internal/tui/keys.go:73` binds lower-case `s` only) opens the pane for the active project on every screen with an active project; `esc` closes it. While another text input owns the keyboard (`projectTextEntry`, `internal/tui/projects.go:23-27`) the key types text.
- Body, one block per owner with a heading line, `KEY  VALUE` lines, values clipped to the width with an ellipsis: `ork (projects.json)`, `ork (global)`, `slicer config` (only `relay_contract`, `check_command`, `claim_owner` and `implement_finish`; the rest of slicer's config is in `ork projects show --json`), `slicer relay roles` (one line per row: id, role, agent, model, reasoning, ork's `use`), `adj` (`enabled`, `config file`). A part error shows slicer's code and message dimmed in its block. `vendor_env` values are not shown, only keys (`docs/state.md:152-157`). `j`/`k` and `pgup`/`pgdown` scroll as in the item pane.
- Setup keys in the pane: `i` opens a one-line chooser of the steps that apply (`slicer-init` when the slicer config part failed with no project; `relay-roles-init` when the matrix part is `no_relay_roles`; `adj-init` when adj is off; `adj-off` when it is on); the chosen step calls `project.setup` with `preview: true`, shows `Run: <command>` and `[y/N] (Enter is No)`; `y` runs it and reloads the pane; slicer's or adj's refusal is shown verbatim. `m` opens the Roadmap's matrix pane for this project.
- No field editing: the hint line names `ork projects set` for that .

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:

- `internal/tui/settings_test.go` (new).
- `internal/tui/daemon.go:163-170` (the `ProjectsShow` and `ProjectSetup` calls on `Daemon`, beside `RolesMatrix`; an optional interface in `settings.go`, as `itemNoter` is, so `Live` and its fakes stay as they are).
- `internal/tui/model.go` (route the key and the replies, beside the matrix reply case).

- `internal/tui/view.go` (draw the pane like the item pane).
- `testdata/golden/settings-100x30-mono-false.txt` (new; written by the tests; the 80x24 and mono variants follow the same naming).

- `CHANGELOG.md` (entry under `## Unreleased`, *proposed*).

Class: N (TUI package, goldens and docs only; it uses the daemon package's types). UI slice: yes.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
With a fake `Live` that also implements the optional interface and records calls (like `matrixLive` in `internal/tui/matrix_test.go:20-40`):
- `TestSettingsKeyOpensThePaneForTheActiveProject`: `S` sends one `ProjectsShow` for the active project; with no active project, no daemon, or a `Live` without the interface, it does nothing and the status says why. Fails first: the key does nothing.
- `TestSettingsPaneGroupsByOwner`: the five headings in order; `vendor_env` shows keys and no values.
- `TestSettingsPaneShowsPartErrors`: a `no_relay_roles` error shows in the relay roles block; the other blocks still draw.
- `TestSettingsSetupOffersOnlyStepsThatApply`: with adj on, the chooser lists `adj-off` and not `adj-init`; with a matrix, no `relay-roles-init`.
- `TestSettingsSetupConfirmsAndNeverRunsOnNoOrEnter`: preview call, then `Run: adj init` and `[y/N] (Enter is No)`; `n`, `enter` and `esc` make no run call.
- `TestSettingsSetupYRunsOnceAndReloads`: `y` makes one run call, then one `ProjectsShow`.
- `TestSettingsSetupShowsTheRefusalVerbatim`: slicer's code and message in the status; no reload.
- `TestSettingsPaneIgnoresStaleReplies`: a reply for an earlier request id changes nothing.
- `TestSettingsPaneMOpensTheMatrixPane`.
- `TestSettingsKeyTypesTextInAnInput`: with the note form open, `S` is typed.
- `TestSettingsPaneGoldens`: body and confirm at 80x24 and 100x30, colour and mono (`checkGolden`, `internal/tui/golden_test.go:147`).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Do not start before `projects-show` and `project-setup` have landed.
2. Write the failing tests; see each fail for the reason given.
3. Pane state and drawing on the item pane's pattern (`internal/tui/roadmap.go:20-27`); daemon calls in `tea.Cmd`s, never in `Update`.
4. Key routing, hint line (the new field drops before `esc close`, `q quit` and `? help` at 80 columns), help.
5. `go test ./internal/tui -update`, then review the new goldens; no existing golden may change except hint lines, if any.
6. Docs; CHANGELOG last.
7. Do not touch `internal/daemon`, `internal/cli`, `internal/slicercli`, or the matrix pane's drawing.

UI slice: UI pass (r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test -race -count=1 ./internal/tui`
- `go test -race -count=1 ./...`
- `go vet ./...`
- `gofmt -l .` (must print nothing)
- `slicer check`
- `adj lint`
- [HUMAN CHECK] At 100x30 and 80x24, with a scratch project registered (no `.slicer/`, no `.adjudicate.json`), open the pane, run `slicer-init`, `relay-roles-init` and `adj-init` from it, and see each block fill in. Not against this repository.
